title: Nirantar Classic plan: benefits and limits
text: Nirantar Classic is the entry-level individual and family floater plan from Tulsivan Health Insurance, sold with a sum insured of ₹3 lakh, ₹5 lakh or ₹7.5 lakh. Room rent is capped at 1% of the sum insured per day, subject to a maximum of ₹5,000 per day, and ICU charges are capped at 2% of the sum insured per day, subject to a maximum of ₹10,000 per day. If you choose a room whose daily rent is above your limit, all associated medical expenses, such as doctor and surgeon fees, nursing charges and operation theatre charges, are paid in the same proportion as the eligible room rent bears to the actual room rent. Medicines, consumables, implants and diagnostic tests are not reduced. Pre-hospitalisation expenses are covered for 30 days before admission and post-hospitalisation expenses for 60 days after discharge. Road ambulance is covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation. In-patient AYUSH treatment taken at a government-recognised hospital is covered up to ₹25,000 per policy year; AYUSH treatment as an outpatient is not covered. A co-payment of 20% applies to every claim under Nirantar Classic, whatever the age of the insured person. Pre-existing diseases are covered after a waiting period of 36 months of continuous cover. Entry age is 18 to 60 years for adults and 91 days to 25 years for dependent children. Nirantar Classic does not include maternity cover, air ambulance or restoration of the sum insured.

title: Nirantar Plus plan: benefits and limits
text: Nirantar Plus is the comprehensive plan from Tulsivan Health Insurance, sold with a sum insured of ₹10 lakh, ₹15 lakh or ₹25 lakh. There is no room rent cap: any single private room is covered at actual cost, and ICU charges are paid in full. Because there is no cap, no proportionate deduction is applied to other hospital charges. Pre-hospitalisation expenses are covered for 60 days before admission and post-hospitalisation expenses for 90 days after discharge. Road ambulance is covered up to ₹5,000 per hospitalisation, and air ambulance up to ₹2.5 lakh once per policy year. In-patient AYUSH treatment is covered up to the full sum insured. Pre-existing diseases are covered after a waiting period of 24 months of continuous cover. Maternity is covered after a waiting period of 24 months, up to ₹50,000 for a normal delivery and ₹75,000 for a caesarean delivery, and a newborn baby is covered from birth until the next renewal. If the sum insured is used up during a policy year, it is restored once, up to 100% of the base sum insured, for a later claim for an unrelated illness. Nirantar Plus has no age-based co-payment for people who join before age 61; people who join at age 61 or above pay a 10% co-payment on every claim. A zone-based co-payment may also apply; see the co-payment rules. A free health check-up worth up to ₹2,500 per adult is offered at a network diagnostic centre after every policy year. Entry age is 18 to 65 years for adults.

title: Waiting periods on all health plans
text: A waiting period is the time from the start of your first policy with Tulsivan Health Insurance during which certain treatments are not covered. Waiting periods count only while cover is continuous; if a policy lapses, they start again from the date of the new policy. Initial waiting period: no claim is payable for any illness that begins in the first 30 days of the first policy. Claims arising from an accident are covered from the first day. Specific illness waiting period: 24 months for a listed set of conditions, including cataract, hernia, benign prostate enlargement, gallbladder and kidney stones, joint replacement (unless needed because of an accident), sinusitis and varicose veins. Pre-existing disease waiting period: 36 months on Nirantar Classic and 24 months on Nirantar Plus. A pre-existing disease is any condition, such as diabetes, hypertension or a thyroid disorder, that was diagnosed or treated within 36 months before the first policy started. It must be declared in the proposal form, and undeclared conditions can lead to a claim being rejected. Maternity waiting period: 24 months, Nirantar Plus only. If you increase your sum insured at renewal, the waiting periods apply afresh to the increased portion only. Hospitalisation means admission for at least 24 consecutive hours, except for listed day-care procedures such as dialysis, chemotherapy and cataract surgery, which need less than 24 hours.

title: Cashless treatment and pre-authorisation
text: Cashless treatment is available at over 9,200 network hospitals across India. The current list, searchable by city and pin code, is in the Tulsivan app and on our website. It changes every month, so please check it before admission. At a non-network hospital you pay the bill yourself and claim reimbursement. Planned admission: the hospital's insurance desk must send the pre-authorisation request to us at least 72 hours before the admission. Emergency admission: the hospital must send the request within 24 hours of admission. With the request the hospital attaches the doctor's notes, investigation reports and the estimated cost. We give an initial decision within 1 hour of receiving a complete request, and the final discharge approval within 3 hours of receiving the hospital's final bill. If we need more information, the clock starts again when the hospital sends it. The approved amount can be enhanced during the stay if the treatment changes. At discharge you pay the hospital directly for anything not covered, such as the co-payment, non-medical items like toiletries and attendant charges, and any amount above your room rent entitlement. If cashless is denied, it does not mean the claim is rejected; you can still pay the hospital and file for reimbursement, and we will review the claim afresh. Show your Tulsivan e-card and a photo ID at the hospital insurance desk.

title: Claim intimation and reimbursement timelines, effective 1 April 2023
text: This page sets out when you must tell Tulsivan Health Insurance about a hospitalisation and when reimbursement documents are due. It applies to all policies issued or renewed from 1 April 2023. Emergency admission: intimate us within 48 hours of admission, by calling the 24-hour claims line or through the app. Planned admission: intimate us at least 72 hours before admission. Reimbursement claims: send the claim form and all documents within 30 days of discharge. Post-hospitalisation bills can be sent within 30 days of the end of the post-hospitalisation period. Late submission may be accepted if you give a written reason, such as a further hospital stay or a death in the family, and we will consider it on merit. Originals are required for all reimbursement claims, and they must be sent by courier to our claims office in Pune. We settle or reject a reimbursement claim within 30 days of receiving the last necessary document. If we take longer than this, we pay interest at 2% above the bank rate for the period of delay. You can track the status of a claim in the app or by calling the claims line with your claim number.

title: Claim intimation and reimbursement timelines, effective 1 June 2026 (replaces the April 2023 version)
text: This page replaces the claim timelines effective 1 April 2023 and applies to all claims for admissions on or after 1 June 2026. Emergency admission: intimate us within 24 hours of admission, by calling the 24-hour claims line on 1800 270 4455 or through the Tulsivan app. Planned admission: intimate us at least 72 hours before admission. Reimbursement claims: send the claim form and all documents within 15 days of discharge. This is shorter than many people expect, so please start collecting papers before you leave the hospital. Post-hospitalisation bills must be sent within 15 days of the end of the post-hospitalisation period. Late submission is accepted only with a written reason, and we decide on merit. Originals or scans: for reimbursement claims up to ₹50,000, clear scans uploaded in the app are enough, and you keep the originals for 12 months in case we ask for them. For claims above ₹50,000, originals must be couriered to our claims office in Pune or handed in at a branch. We settle or reject a reimbursement claim within 30 days of receiving the last necessary document, and pay interest at 2% above the bank rate for any delay beyond that. You can track every claim in the app or by calling the claims line with your claim number.

title: Reimbursement claim document checklist
text: For a reimbursement claim, please send the following. The claim form, part A signed by the policyholder and part B filled in and stamped by the hospital. The discharge summary. The final hospital bill with a detailed break-up, and the payment receipt. Pharmacy bills with the matching doctor's prescriptions. All investigation reports, such as blood tests and scans, with the doctor's note asking for them. For surgery, the implant sticker or invoice, if an implant was used. A cancelled cheque or bank statement page showing the account holder's name and IFSC code, for payment by NEFT. PAN card and Aadhaar or another KYC document of the policyholder, if the claim is above ₹1 lakh. For accidents, a copy of the FIR or medico-legal certificate, if one was made. For a death claim, the death certificate and the nominee's ID and bank details. Missing documents are the most common reason for delay. We send one reminder for missing items, and if they do not arrive within 15 days of the reminder, the claim is closed; it can be reopened if you send them later with a reason. Upload scans in the Tulsivan app under Claims, then Reimbursement, or courier originals to: Claims Department, Tulsivan Health Insurance, 4th Floor, Kalyani Towers, Baner Road, Pune 411045. Write your policy number and claim number on the envelope.

title: Cumulative bonus (no-claim bonus)
text: Tulsivan Health Insurance rewards claim-free years with a cumulative bonus, often called a no-claim bonus. For every policy year in which no claim is paid, your sum insured increases by 20% of the base sum insured at renewal, up to a maximum of 100% of the base sum insured. For example, a Nirantar Plus policy with a base sum insured of ₹10 lakh can grow to ₹20 lakh after five claim-free years, at no extra premium. The bonus is not a premium discount; your premium stays based on the base sum insured. Our rule after a claim is stricter than many plans. If any claim is paid in a policy year, whether cashless or reimbursement and whatever the amount, the entire accumulated cumulative bonus is withdrawn at the next renewal, and the sum insured goes back to the base amount. The bonus then starts building again from zero. Using the free annual health check-up does not count as a claim. On a family floater, a claim for any one member removes the bonus for the whole family. If you port your policy to Tulsivan, bonus earned with your previous insurer is carried over, up to the same 100% maximum. The bonus is lost if the policy lapses after the grace period ends.

title: Co-payment rules
text: A co-payment is the share of every admissible claim that you pay yourself, with Tulsivan Health Insurance paying the rest. Co-payments are applied after all other limits, such as room rent caps. Nirantar Classic: a co-payment of 20% applies to every claim, for every insured person, whatever their age. It is not limited to senior citizens. For example, on an admissible claim of ₹1,00,000, we pay ₹80,000 and you pay ₹20,000. Nirantar Plus: there is no co-payment for people who join before age 61. People who join Nirantar Plus at age 61 or above pay a 10% co-payment on every claim. Zone-based co-payment: Nirantar Plus premiums are set by zone. Zone A covers Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Kolkata, Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Pune; every other city is Zone B. If you pay the Zone B premium and take treatment in a Zone A city, an extra co-payment of 15% applies to that claim, because hospital costs in Zone A cities are higher. Emergency admissions after an accident are exempt from the zone co-payment. You can remove the zone co-payment at any renewal by switching to the Zone A premium. On a cashless claim, you pay the co-payment amount to the hospital at discharge.

title: Renewal, grace period and premium payment
text: Renewal reminders are sent by email, SMS and WhatsApp 45 days, 15 days and 3 days before your policy end date. Grace period: if you have not renewed by the end date, you have a grace period of 7 days to pay the renewal premium. This is shorter than the 30 days many insurers allow, so please renew on time. Any hospitalisation that begins during the grace period is not covered, but if you pay within the 7 days, your waiting period credit and cumulative bonus continue as if there had been no break. If you pay after the 7 days, the policy has lapsed: you must apply for a fresh policy, waiting periods start again and any bonus is lost. Premium payment modes: Tulsivan Health Insurance accepts premiums only as an annual premium, or as a single premium for a 2-year policy or a 3-year policy. We do not offer monthly, quarterly or half-yearly instalments. A 2-year policy gets a discount of 7.5% and a 3-year policy a discount of 10%. You can pay by UPI, debit or credit card, net banking, or cheque at a branch. Cheques take 3 working days to clear, and the policy is renewed only once the cheque clears. Premiums are revised by age band: 18 to 35, 36 to 45, 46 to 50, 51 to 55, 56 to 60, and five-year bands after that.

title: Porting a health policy to Tulsivan
text: Portability lets you move your health policy from another insurer to Tulsivan Health Insurance without losing credit for the waiting periods you have already served. Apply at least 45 days and not more than 60 days before your current policy's renewal date. Applications received less than 45 days before renewal are accepted only at our discretion. Send the portability form, copies of your current and previous policy schedules for all continuous years, your claim history, and the proposal form with full health disclosure. We may ask for a medical check-up, which we pay for. We decide within 15 days of receiving a complete application. Waiting period credit is given only up to the sum insured of your previous policy. If you choose a higher sum insured with us, the waiting periods for pre-existing diseases and specific illnesses apply afresh to the increased portion. For example, if you had ₹5 lakh for three years elsewhere and port to Nirantar Plus with ₹10 lakh, a pre-existing condition is covered up to ₹5 lakh straight away, but the extra ₹5 lakh is covered for it only after 24 months. Cumulative bonus earned with your previous insurer is added to your sum insured. Your old policy must stay active until the ported policy starts; any gap in cover ends portability, and the application is then treated as a new policy.

title: Free-look period and cancellation
text: Every new Tulsivan Health Insurance policy comes with a free-look period of 30 days from the date you receive the policy document, whether by email or post. During this time you can review the terms and cancel the policy if it does not suit you, provided no claim has been made. The free-look period does not apply to renewals. Refund on free-look cancellation: the premium is refunded after deducting the stamp duty paid on the policy, the cost of any pre-policy medical check-up we paid for, and a pro-rata risk premium for the days the policy was in force. It is not a 100% refund. Refunds are credited to the original payment method within 7 working days of the cancellation request. Cancellation after the free-look period: you can cancel at any time by sending a written request from the policyholder. If no claim has been made, we refund part of the premium on a short-period scale: cancelled within 3 months of the start, 75% refund; within 6 months, 50% refund; within 9 months, 25% refund; after 9 months, no refund. If a claim has been paid in the policy year, no refund is made. Multi-year policies are refunded in proportion to the complete unexpired years, plus the short-period refund for the current year.

title: Contact numbers, branch hours and grievances
text: Claims and cashless helpline: 1800 270 4455, open 24 hours a day, every day, including public holidays. General customer service: 1800 270 4400, Monday to Saturday, 8:00 am to 8:00 pm. Email: care@tulsivanhealth.in, replied to within 2 working days. WhatsApp self-service on 98200 45500 for e-cards, policy copies and claim status. Branches: Tulsivan Health Insurance has 64 branches. Branches are open Monday to Friday, 9:30 am to 5:30 pm, and on the first, third and fifth Saturdays of the month from 9:30 am to 1:30 pm. Branches are closed on the second and fourth Saturdays, on Sundays and on national holidays. You can hand in original claim documents, nominee change forms and cheque payments at any branch, and you will get an acknowledgement slip. Grievances: if you are unhappy with a reply, write to the Grievance Officer at grievance@tulsivanhealth.in. We acknowledge within 24 hours and resolve within 14 days. If the matter is still unresolved after 30 days, you may approach the Insurance Ombudsman for your area.

title: Changing your nominee, address or members
text: You can update most policy details during the policy year without any fee. Nominee: the nominee is the person who receives claim money due to the policyholder if the policyholder dies. To change your nominee, submit the signed nominee change form at any branch or upload a signed scan in the Tulsivan app under Policy, then Service requests. For security, nominee changes cannot be made over the phone or by email. The change is recorded within 7 working days, and you receive an updated policy schedule by email. Address and contact details can be changed in the app instantly, or over the phone after OTP verification. A change of city may change your premium zone at the next renewal. Adding members: a spouse can be added only at renewal. A newborn can be added mid-term within 90 days of birth by paying the pro-rata premium. Removing members: a member can be removed at renewal, or mid-term on death, divorce or a child turning 25, with a pro-rata refund if no claim was made for that member. Sum insured can be changed only at renewal, and an increase may need a medical check-up for people aged 46 or above. A change of plan from Nirantar Classic to Nirantar Plus is allowed at renewal; waiting periods already served carry over up to the old sum insured.
